LAREDO, Texas — Pablo Daniel Esquivel was arrested Tuesday afternoon, October 21, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged first-degree felony charge of aggravated assault against a date, family member, or household member with a weapon causing serious bodily injury, according to Webb County booking records.

Esquivel was arrested at 5:47 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department. The booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956 listed one charge.

Bond was set at $75,000, according to the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A first-degree felony in Texas is punishable by five to 99 years in prison or life, and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Pablo Daniel Esquivel is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
